room.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# in the room} other {# in the room}}
room.count.description: How many are in a voice chat room, for assistive technology, beside the people glyph and the figure: in a room's line of a list, its title and the call's bar.

room.count_max.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# of {max} in the room} other {# of {max} in the room}}
room.count_max.description: How many are in a voice chat room against its maximum ({max}, a number), for assistive technology, beside the people glyph and the figures shown as "8 / 10": in a room's title and the call's bar. Count may exceed max after the maximum was lowered.

room.hosted_by.description: Under a voice chat room's name in a list of rooms (the rooms' screen, a hashtag's page): who hosts it ({host}, a display name).

room.entry_hosting.description: Under the name of the voice chat room on the profile of the account that hosts it: they are hosting it now.

room.entry_speaking.description: Under the name of the voice chat room on the profile of an account that speaks in it: they are a speaker in it now.
